geometryBasis: Original OSM way220662077 explicitly named HartRAO26-metre IVS VLBI antenna telescope with telescope:diameter=26m. Separate C-BASS/XDM/HIRAX instruments and the general observatory POI are different identities.
authoringDirection: Build the white parabolic26m reflector, central receiver/feed with open triangular struts, rear radial ribs, inclined polar/hour-axis framework and four splayed open steel feet/footings shown in both inspected NASA photographs. Use an illustrative observing pose; no claim of current operational pointing. Detached background instruments/campus/containers/fences excluded. Retain empty spaces in the mount; do not substitute a solid pedestal or generic dish on a stick.
